summary: CompactString::retain updated its length only on normal completion. A predicate panic after compacting characters left the original length, potentially exposing invalid UTF-8. The regression test added by the fix removes the first '0' from "0è0", retains 'è', then panics on the final character; the stale length exposes a stray continuation byte. The fix uses a drop guard to truncate to the retained prefix even during unwinding. The proposed reversal restores the exact parent implementation and preserves the upstream test. No tests were run.
